body: One day, I went to the park with my dog, Max. The sun was shining, and it was a perfect day. Max was very happy. He ran around and wagged his tail. We played fetch with a ball. I threw the ball, and Max ran to get it. He brought it back to me, and I threw it again. We played for a long time. Then, we took a break and sat under a big tree. I gave Max some water, and I had a snack. We saw other people in the park. Some were walking, and others were playing. Max made friends with another dog. They played together and had a lot of fun. After a while, we went home. Max was tired and fell asleep. It was a wonderful day at the park. Max and I had a lot of fun together.

Hi! My name is Sarah! I am 25 years old, and I live in Currie, Scotland. I am looking forward to this fall because I am going to France with my good friend, Andrew. Usually, I have to work during the fall, but this fall I am going to travel around fall. We are going hiking in the South of France, and after we are going to visit some museums. We are also going to visit all the big cities and experience the culture. I am excited to visit some old friends that live in France. My friend, Jacob, who is a librarian, lives in Bordeaux, so hopefully we will spend a week or two with him. Who knows, maybe I will find a new job in France and never return to Scottland!

Hello everyone! My name is Alex. I am 25 years old and I reside in Madrid, Spain. This summer, I am going to travel all over North America with my best friend, Jamie. We are going to begin in Canada and make our way down to the United States! We are really thrilled for this journey and have been planning it for a long time. We both have careers, so we had to save up a lot of money to be able to afford it, but it will be worth it! We are going to see some incredible places and meet some incredible people. I am most excited to visit the United States because I love basketball, and my hero is LeBron James. We have also arranged to volunteer at a technology institute in San Francisco. I am very excited to get started!

I have a small family, and we live in a cozy house. There is my mom, dad, and my little sister. My mom is a teacher, and she loves to read books. My dad works in an office, and he likes to cook on weekends. My sister is five years old, and she is very funny. We like to eat dinner together every night, and we talk about our day. On weekends, we go to the park, play games, or watch movies. Sometimes, we visit our grandparents, and they tell us interesting stories. We also enjoy going to the beach in the summer. My family is very important to me, and we have a lot of fun together. We support each other and share happy moments. I love my family very much, and they make me feel loved and safe.

Yesterday was a busy but fun day for me. I woke up early in the morning and had a big breakfast. I ate cereal, toast, and an apple. After breakfast, I went to school. I had math, science, and English classes. I like English because we read interesting stories. After school, I did my homework at home. It took me about an hour. In the afternoon, I played soccer with my friends at the park. We had a great time running and kicking the ball. In the evening, I helped my mom cook dinner. We made spaghetti and salad. After dinner, I watched TV with my family. We watched a funny movie, and we laughed a lot. Before going to bed, I read a book for a while. I had a good day yesterday, and I felt happy and tired at the end.

My favorite food is pizza, and I love eating it anytime. I like pizza with lots of cheese and tomatoes. Sometimes, I add mushrooms and green peppers too. On weekends, my family and I often go to a pizza restaurant. We enjoy trying different types of pizza. My favorite is the classic Margherita pizza. It has a simple and delicious taste. Sometimes, my dad makes pizza at home. He makes the dough, and I help put the toppings. It is fun to make pizza together. When the pizza is ready, we all sit down and eat it. The hot, melted cheese and crispy crust make it taste so good. I also like to eat pizza with my friends. We talk and laugh while enjoying our food. Pizza is not only delicious but also a special meal that brings people together.

Today is a sunny day, and it makes me feel happy. The sky is blue, and the sun is shining bright. I love sunny days because I can go outside and have fun. In the morning, I went to the park with my family. We walked around and enjoyed the fresh air. I saw many flowers and birds. After that, I played on the swings and slides with my sister. We had a lot of fun. In the afternoon, I rode my bike around the neighborhood. The warm sun felt nice on my skin. I also met my friends, and we played soccer together. We laughed and ran around for hours. In the evening, we had a barbecue in our backyard. The food was tasty, and we enjoyed eating outside. Sunny days are the best because I can do many fun things. They make me feel happy and full of energy.

I have a pet dog, and his name is Max. Max is a small, brown dog with soft fur and big, shiny eyes. He is very friendly and loves to play. Every morning, I take Max for a walk around the neighborhood. He likes to sniff around and explore new places. Sometimes, he meets other dogs and plays with them. At home, Max has a special place where he sleeps. He has a comfy bed and some toys to play with. Max loves to eat his food, and he always gets excited when it is mealtime. In the afternoon, we often play in the garden. I throw a ball, and Max runs to catch it. He is very fast and always brings the ball back to me. Max makes me very happy. He is a good friend, and I love spending time with him.

Every morning, I get ready to go to school. I wake up early, eat breakfast, and pack my bag. My school is not far from my house, so I walk there. I like walking to school because I can see my friends on the way. When I reach school, I go to my classroom. My teacher is very nice, and she teaches us many things. We have different subjects like math, science, and English. My favorite subject is English because I enjoy reading and writing stories. During the break, I play with my friends in the playground. We run, play games, and have a lot of fun. After school, I sometimes go to the library to read books or do my homework. Going to school is important because I learn new things every day. I like my school and my friends, and I always have a good time there.

My best friend’s name is Anna. We have been friends since we were little. Anna is very kind and funny. She has long brown hair and big blue eyes. We go to the same school and are in the same class. Every day, we sit together and share our lunch. After school, we like to play in the park. Sometimes, we ride our bikes or play soccer. On weekends, we often have sleepovers at each other’s houses. We watch movies, eat popcorn, and talk about everything. Anna has a pet cat named Whiskers. We love to play with Whiskers and take funny pictures. Anna and I help each other with homework too. If I do not understand something, Anna explains it to me. She is very smart. I am very lucky to have Anna as my best friend. We have a lot of fun together, and she makes me very happy.

Last weekend, my family and I went on a trip to the beach. The weather was perfect, with the sun shining and a cool breeze. We packed our bags with towels, sunscreen, and snacks. When we reached the beach, I felt so excited. The sand was warm under my feet, and the water looked blue and inviting. My sister and I built a big sandcastle with towers and a moat. We decorated it with seashells we found on the shore. After that, we played in the water. The waves were gentle, and we had fun splashing around. We also collected some pretty stones and seaweed. For lunch, we had sandwiches and fruit. It was delicious to eat while listening to the sound of the waves. In the afternoon, we flew a kite. It went high up in the sky. Our day at the beach was wonderful. I hope we go again soon.

My bedroom is my favorite place in the house. It is small but very cozy. The walls are painted light blue, and I have some posters of my favorite animals. My bed is next to the window, and I have a soft blanket and many pillows. I like to read books on my bed before I go to sleep. I also have a small desk where I do my homework. On the desk, there is a lamp, some pencils, and my notebooks. Next to the desk, I have a shelf with my books and toys. I keep my room clean and tidy because I like it that way. I also have a small closet for my clothes. I like to decorate my room with pictures and drawings. My bedroom is a place where I can relax and be myself. I love spending time in my room.

In my free time, I like to do many fun activities. I enjoy reading books because they take me to different worlds. My favorite books are about adventures and magic. I also like to draw and paint. I use crayons and watercolors to make colorful pictures. Sometimes, I listen to music and dance around my room. It makes me feel happy and energetic. On weekends, I often go to the park with my friends. We play games like soccer or hide and seek. I also like to ride my bike. It is fun to go fast and feel the wind on my face. At home, I help my mom in the kitchen. We bake cookies and cakes. They taste so good! I also like to watch movies with my family. We sit together and eat popcorn. My free time is very special to me. It makes me feel happy and relaxed.

Last Saturday, I went to my friend’s birthday party. Her name is Lisa, and she turned eight years old. The party was at her house, and it was very fun. When I arrived, I gave Lisa a gift. It was a coloring book and some crayons. She liked it a lot. There were many balloons and decorations in the living room. We played games like musical chairs and pin the tail on the donkey. I won a small prize in one of the games. After the games, we ate delicious food. There were sandwiches, pizza, and lots of snacks. My favorite part was the cake. It was big and had chocolate frosting. Lisa blew out the candles, and we all sang “Happy Birthday.” After eating, we danced and listened to music. At the end of the party, Lisa gave everyone a small gift bag. It was a great birthday party, and I had a lot of fun.

My favorite color is blue. I like blue because it is the color of the sky and the ocean. Blue makes me feel calm and happy. Many things around me are blue. I have a blue backpack that I take to school every day. My room has blue walls, and my bedspread is also blue. I like to wear blue clothes because they look nice on me. My favorite blue item is my toy car. It is bright blue and very fast. When I draw pictures, I often use blue to color the sky and water. In the summer, I love going to the beach and looking at the blue sea. Blue is a beautiful and peaceful color. It is also the color of blueberries, which are my favorite fruit. Whenever I see blue, it makes me smile. I think blue is the best color in the world.

I love taking a walk in the park. It is a nice place to relax and enjoy nature. The park near my house is very big and beautiful. It has tall trees, green grass, and many flowers. In the morning, I often go to the park with my family. We walk on the paths and enjoy the fresh air. Sometimes, we see squirrels and birds. They are fun to watch. I like to sit on a bench and look at the flowers. They have many colors like red, yellow, and pink. There is also a small pond in the park. Ducks swim in the pond, and I like to feed them bread. In the afternoon, I play with my friends in the park. We run, play soccer, and ride our bikes. A walk in the park makes me feel happy and relaxed. It is a wonderful way to spend my time.

I go to a nice school. It is not very big, but it has many friendly teachers and students. My school has a playground, a library, and a big classroom. Every morning, I walk to school with my friends. We talk and laugh on the way. My favorite subject is English because I like reading stories and writing. Our teacher, Mrs. Smith, is very kind and helps us learn new things. During the break, I play with my friends in the playground. We run, play tag, and sometimes we play soccer. The library in our school has many books. I like to read books about animals and adventures. After school, I sometimes stay for extra activities. We have art and music classes. I enjoy drawing and singing. My school is a special place where I learn and have fun. I like my school very much.

One of my favorite games to play is hide and seek. It is a simple but very fun game. I often play it with my friends in the park or at home. In this game, one person closes their eyes and counts to ten. The other players hide in different places. After counting, the person tries to find everyone. We laugh a lot while hiding and looking for each other. Sometimes, we find very good hiding spots, and it takes a long time to be found. When everyone is found, we take turns and let someone else be the seeker. We also make some rules to make the game fair. For example, we agree on areas where we can and cannot hide. Playing hide and seek is a great way to spend time with friends. It makes us run, think, and have a lot of fun together. I love playing this game.

Every morning, I follow a routine to get ready for the day. I wake up early at 7 o’clock. First, I brush my teeth and wash my face. Then, I change into my school clothes. After that, I go to the kitchen and have breakfast. My mom makes a delicious breakfast with eggs, toast, and fruit. After eating, I pack my school bag. I make sure I have my books, notebooks, and a pencil case. I also pack my lunchbox with some snacks. Before leaving, I check my homework to make sure I did everything. At 8 o’clock, I leave the house and walk to school. I like to walk because it wakes me up and I can see my friends on the way. My morning routine helps me start my day in a good way. It makes me feel ready and happy to go to school.

Last Sunday, my family and I visited the zoo. It was a sunny day, and we were very excited. The zoo is a big place with many animals. When we arrived, we first saw the elephants. They were big and had long trunks. We watched them eat and play with water. Next, we went to see the lions. They were resting under a tree. I liked their big manes. We also saw giraffes with long necks. They were eating leaves from tall trees. In the bird section, we saw colorful parrots and flamingos. They looked very beautiful. My favorite part was the monkey area. The monkeys were very playful and funny. They jumped around and made us laugh. We also visited the reptile house and saw snakes and turtles. Before leaving, we had some ice cream. It was a wonderful day at the zoo. I learned a lot about animals and had a great time.

My favorite book is called "The Adventures of Tom Sawyer." It is a story about a boy named Tom who lives in a small town. Tom is very curious and likes to have fun. He goes on many adventures with his friends. They play games, explore caves, and find treasure. The book is very exciting and full of surprises. I like Tom because he is brave and clever. He always finds a way to solve problems. The story takes place in the past, and it is interesting to read about how people lived back then. The book has many funny and happy moments. It also teaches good lessons about friendship and being kind. I enjoy reading "The Adventures of Tom Sawyer" because it takes me to a different world. It makes me feel like I am part of the story. This book is very special to me, and I can read it again and again.

Last Saturday, I had a wonderful day out with my family. We decided to go to the countryside for a picnic. In the morning, we packed some food, drinks, and a blanket. We also took a ball and some games. The countryside was very beautiful and peaceful. When we arrived, we found a nice spot under a big tree. We spread the blanket and sat down. We ate sandwiches, fruits, and cookies. The food tasted very good. After eating, we played games. My dad and I played soccer, and my mom and sister played badminton. We also flew a kite. It went high up in the sky. Later, we took a walk and saw some animals like cows and sheep. The fresh air and green fields made us feel happy. In the evening, we watched the sunset. It was very beautiful. Our day out in the countryside was perfect. I had a lot of fun with my family.

When I grow up, I want to be a doctor. I think being a doctor is very important and special. Doctors help people when they are sick or hurt. They make people feel better and save lives. I like helping others, and I want to learn how to take care of people. I also want to study hard and learn about the human body. My favorite subject in school is science. I enjoy learning about how things work. I know that becoming a doctor is not easy. It takes a lot of hard work and study. But I am ready to work hard and do my best. I want to make my family proud and help my community. When I see doctors in the hospital, I feel inspired. I hope one day I can wear a white coat and help people just like them. This is my dream, and I will work hard to achieve it.

Winter is my favorite season. I love the cold weather and the snow. When it snows, I like to play outside. I build snowmen with my friends. We also have snowball fights. It is so much fun! I wear warm clothes like a coat, hat, and gloves. At home, I drink hot chocolate. It tastes so good when it is cold outside. In winter, the days are shorter and the nights are longer. I like to sit by the fireplace and read books. Sometimes, we go ice skating. It is a little difficult, but I enjoy it. During winter holidays, we decorate our house with lights. My family and I have a big dinner together. Winter is a special time of the year. It is full of fun activities and cozy moments. I always look forward to winter and all the joy it brings.

On rainy days, I like to stay inside and do fun activities. I watch movies with my family. We sit on the couch with a blanket and eat popcorn. Sometimes, I read my favorite books. The sound of the rain outside makes it very relaxing. I also enjoy drawing and coloring. I use many colors to make my pictures bright and happy. My sister and I play board games. We laugh and have a lot of fun. My mom makes hot soup, and it is very tasty. We sit by the window and watch the raindrops. Sometimes, we see lightning and hear thunder. It is exciting! When the rain stops, we go outside and look for rainbows. Rainy days are cozy and special. Even though we stay inside, we find many ways to enjoy the day. It is a nice break from the sunny weather.

My favorite animal is the panda. Pandas are very cute and fluffy. They have black and white fur. Pandas live in the forests of China. They like to eat bamboo. They spend most of their time eating and sleeping. Pandas are good climbers. They can climb trees to find food or take a nap. Baby pandas are very small and adorable. They stay close to their mothers. I like watching videos of pandas. They are very playful and funny. Pandas are also very calm and peaceful animals. They do not harm other animals. Sometimes, pandas play with each other. They roll around and have fun. I hope to see a panda in real life one day. They are very special animals. Pandas are my favorite because they are cute, gentle, and unique. I always enjoy learning more about them.

Last night, I watched a fun movie with my family. It was an animated movie about a brave little mouse. The mouse had many adventures. He helped his friends and fought bad guys. The movie was very funny and exciting. We laughed a lot. The animation was colorful and beautiful. The mouse had big eyes and a cute voice. The story was also very interesting. It taught us about courage and friendship. We ate popcorn and drank juice while watching the movie. It was a perfect way to spend the evening. After the movie, we talked about our favorite parts. We all enjoyed it very much. Watching movies together is one of my favorite things to do. It is fun and brings us closer. I can't wait to watch another fun movie with my family soon.

I live in a small town. It is a quiet and friendly place. There are many trees and parks in my town. I like to go for walks and see the flowers. In the center of the town, there is a big square. People meet there to talk and have fun. There are also small shops and cafes. I enjoy buying ice cream from the local shop. My school is near my house. I walk to school every day with my friends. There is also a library in the town. I go there to read books and do my homework. On weekends, there is a market in the square. People sell fresh fruits and vegetables. It is very colorful and lively. My town is a nice place to live. It is safe, clean, and full of kind people. I love my hometown very much.

Summer is a fun season. The weather is hot and sunny. During summer, I like to go to the beach. I swim in the sea and build sandcastles. Sometimes, I collect shells and pebbles. I also enjoy eating ice cream to cool down. My friends and I play outside a lot. We ride our bikes and play games like tag and hide and seek. In the evening, we have barbecues in the backyard. The food tastes so good! I love the long days in summer. The sun sets late, and we have more time to play. Sometimes, we go camping in the mountains. We make a campfire and tell stories. Summer is also the time for vacations. My family and I visit new places. We explore, have fun, and make great memories. Summer is a wonderful season full of adventures and happiness.

My favorite animal is the cat. Cats are very cute and playful. They have soft fur and sharp claws. Cats like to chase and catch things. My cat's name is Whiskers. He is white with black spots. Whiskers loves to play with a ball of yarn. He runs and jumps around the house. He also likes to climb on furniture. Cats are very good at climbing. Whiskers enjoys sleeping in the sun. He finds a sunny spot and takes a nap. Cats are also very clean. They spend a lot of time grooming themselves. Whiskers is very friendly. He likes to sit on my lap and purr. It makes me feel happy. I love my cat very much. He is a great friend and always makes me smile. Cats are wonderful animals. They are fun, loving, and full of surprises.

I enjoy watching cartoons. They are funny and entertaining. My favorite cartoon is about a group of animals who go on adventures. The main character is a clever rabbit. He always finds a way to solve problems. The other characters are a friendly dog, a brave cat, and a silly duck. They all work together and help each other. The stories are exciting and full of surprises. The animation is colorful and lively. I laugh a lot when I watch cartoons. They make me feel happy and relaxed. Sometimes, I watch cartoons with my friends. We talk about our favorite episodes and characters. Cartoons are not only for kids. They can teach us important lessons too. I learn about friendship, kindness, and courage. Watching cartoons is one of my favorite hobbies. It is a fun way to spend my free time.

My favorite holiday is Christmas. It is a special time of the year. We decorate our house with lights and a Christmas tree. The tree is full of colorful ornaments and a star on top. On Christmas Eve, we have a big dinner with our family. We eat delicious food like roast chicken, potatoes, and pies. After dinner, we sing Christmas songs. On Christmas morning, we open presents. I get very excited to see what I receive. My family and I also give gifts to each other. It is fun to see everyone happy. We spend the day together, playing games and watching movies. In the evening, we go for a walk and see the Christmas lights in our neighborhood. Christmas is a time of joy and love. It brings people together and makes us feel grateful. I love Christmas very much.

My favorite sport is soccer. It is a very exciting game. I like to play soccer with my friends. We go to the park and have fun. In soccer, there are two teams. Each team tries to score goals by kicking the ball into the net. I like to run and kick the ball. It makes me feel strong and happy. Sometimes, I watch soccer matches on TV. My favorite team is very good. They win many games. I cheer for them and feel very excited. I also practice soccer at school. We have a coach who teaches us new skills. Playing soccer helps me stay healthy and fit. It also teaches me to work with others. Soccer is a great sport. It is full of action and teamwork. I enjoy every moment when I play soccer.

Last Sunday, I went on a picnic with my family. We went to a beautiful park. The weather was sunny and warm. We packed a basket with sandwiches, fruits, and drinks. We also took a blanket to sit on. When we arrived at the park, we found a nice spot under a big tree. We spread the blanket and sat down. We ate our food and enjoyed the fresh air. After eating, we played games. My dad and I played catch with a ball. My mom and sister played badminton. We also flew a kite. It went high up in the sky. Later, we took a walk around the park. We saw many flowers and birds. The park was very peaceful. In the evening, we watched the sunset. It was very beautiful. Our picnic was wonderful. We had a lot of fun and made happy memories.

My best friend is Mark. We have known each other since we were little. Mark is very kind and funny. He has short brown hair and blue eyes. We go to the same school and are in the same class. We sit together and help each other with our homework. After school, we like to play in the park. We play soccer and ride our bikes. On weekends, we often have sleepovers. We watch movies, eat popcorn, and tell stories. Mark has a pet dog named Max. We play with Max and take him for walks. Mark is very good at drawing. He teaches me how to draw better. We also play video games together. Mark is a great friend. He always makes me laugh and feel happy. I am very lucky to have him as my best friend. We have a lot of fun together.

I love going to the beach. It is a fun and relaxing place. The sand is warm, and the sea is blue. I like to swim in the sea. The water is cool and refreshing. Sometimes, I build sandcastles with my friends. We make big castles with towers and moats. It is very exciting. I also enjoy collecting seashells. They come in many shapes and colors. We have picnics on the beach. We bring sandwiches, fruits, and drinks. It is nice to eat while listening to the waves. In the afternoon, we play beach volleyball. It is a fun game, and we laugh a lot. I also like to lie on a towel and read a book. The sun feels warm and nice. Going to the beach is one of my favorite activities. It is a perfect way to spend a sunny day. I always have a great time at the beach.

My favorite fruit is the apple. Apples are sweet and juicy. They come in different colors like red, green, and yellow. I like to eat apples for a snack. They are healthy and give me energy. Sometimes, I cut apples into slices and dip them in peanut butter. It tastes very good. I also enjoy apple pie. It is a delicious dessert. My mom makes the best apple pie. She uses fresh apples and a lot of cinnamon. We eat it with ice cream. In the fall, we go apple picking. We visit an apple orchard and pick apples from the trees. It is a fun activity. We take the apples home and make apple juice. I also like to learn about apples. They grow on trees and have seeds inside. Apples are my favorite fruit because they are tasty and healthy.

My favorite toy is a teddy bear. It is very soft and cuddly. My teddy bear's name is Brownie because it is brown. I got Brownie as a birthday present when I was five years old. Brownie has a red bow around its neck. I take Brownie everywhere with me. At night, I sleep with Brownie next to me. It makes me feel safe and happy. When I am sad, I hug Brownie, and it makes me feel better. Brownie is also my friend. I talk to Brownie and tell it my secrets. I like to dress up Brownie in different clothes. Sometimes, I play tea party with Brownie. We have a lot of fun together. My teddy bear is very special to me. It is not just a toy; it is my friend. I love Brownie very much.

My favorite food is pizza. Pizza is very delicious. It has a crispy crust, tasty sauce, and melted cheese. I like to add toppings like pepperoni, mushrooms, and olives. My mom makes homemade pizza. She lets me help her in the kitchen. I spread the sauce and put the toppings on the dough. Then, we bake it in the oven. The smell of pizza makes me very hungry. When it is ready, we cut it into slices. I like to eat pizza with my family. We sit at the table and talk while eating. Sometimes, we order pizza from a restaurant. It comes in a big box. My friends and I enjoy pizza at parties. We play games and have fun. Pizza is my favorite food because it tastes so good. I never get tired of eating it.

I have a pet fish named Goldie. Goldie is a goldfish. It lives in a small tank in my room. Goldie is orange and shiny. I like to watch Goldie swim around. It moves its fins and tail very gracefully. I feed Goldie every day. It eats tiny fish food. I also clean the tank once a week. I change the water and clean the glass. Goldie has a small castle in its tank. It likes to swim in and out of the castle. Sometimes, Goldie makes bubbles in the water. I enjoy taking care of Goldie. It is a quiet and peaceful pet. Goldie is my first pet, and I love it very much. It is fun to watch and makes my room look nice. Having a pet fish is a great experience. I am happy to have Goldie as my pet.

I love celebrating my birthday. It is a very special day. My family and friends make it a lot of fun. In the morning, I wake up to birthday wishes and hugs. My mom makes a delicious breakfast. Sometimes, we go out for a special treat. I get to choose what we do on my birthday. In the afternoon, we have a party. My friends come over, and we play games. We have balloons, decorations, and music. My favorite part is the birthday cake. It is always very tasty and has candles on top. Everyone sings the birthday song, and I make a wish before blowing out the candles. After the cake, we open presents. I feel very happy and loved. Celebrating my birthday is always a great time. I look forward to it every year. It is a day full of joy and fun.

I love playing in the snow. When it snows, everything looks white and beautiful. I put on my warm clothes and go outside. I wear a coat, hat, gloves, and boots. My friends and I build snowmen. We make big balls of snow and stack them to make the body. We use stones for the eyes and a carrot for the nose. It is very fun. We also have snowball fights. We throw snowballs at each other and run around. Sometimes, we make snow angels. We lie down in the snow and move our arms and legs. It makes a shape like an angel. I also enjoy sledding. I sit on a sled and slide down a hill. It is very exciting. Playing in the snow makes me feel happy. It is a special activity that I can only do in winter. I always have a great time in the snow.

My favorite subject in school is art. I love to draw and paint. In art class, we learn about colors and shapes. Our teacher shows us how to use different tools like pencils, brushes, and markers. I enjoy making pictures of animals, nature, and people. Sometimes, we use clay to make sculptures. It is fun to shape and mold the clay. I like to be creative and use my imagination. Art class is very relaxing and enjoyable. I also like to see what my classmates make. We all have different ideas and styles. Our teacher puts our artwork on the wall. It makes me feel proud to see my work displayed. I also like to learn about famous artists. They inspire me to try new things. Art is my favorite subject because it lets me express myself. I always look forward to art class.

Last weekend, I went to visit my grandparents. They live in the countryside. When we arrived, my grandparents were very happy to see us. They gave me a big hug. We had a nice lunch together. My grandmother made my favorite food. After lunch, my grandfather took me to his garden. He showed me his plants and flowers. They were very beautiful. We picked some vegetables and fruits. In the evening, we went for a walk. The countryside is very peaceful. We saw cows and sheep. I also saw a beautiful sunset. It made the sky look orange and pink. When we got back, we had dinner. My grandmother made a delicious pie. Before bed, my grandfather told me a story. It was very interesting. I had a great time at my grandparents’ house. I love visiting them.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She lived in a small village. Lily loved to read books. She read every day. One day, she found a special book in the library. It was very old and had a shiny cover. When she opened it, a bright light came out. Suddenly, Lily was in a magical land. She saw fairies, talking animals, and colorful flowers. Lily made friends with a talking rabbit. The rabbit showed her around the magical land. They went on many adventures. They helped a fairy find her lost wand. They also saved a bird from a big tree. Sometimes, there are feeding sessions or talks by zookeepers that are educational. The zoo is a great place to see and appreciate wildlife. I also enjoy taking photos and sharing them with friends. Visiting the zoo helps me understand the importance of wildlife conservation and provides a fun day out.

I enjoy going to a dance class. The class teaches different styles of dance, like salsa, hip-hop, and ballet. I like to learn new steps and practice my moves. Dancing is a great way to stay active and have fun. I enjoy the music and the rhythm of the dance. The class also helps me improve my coordination and flexibility. Dancing with others is exciting and creates a sense of teamwork. Sometimes, we perform at events or shows, which is a lot of fun. Going to dance class is a wonderful way to express myself and enjoy the art of movement.

Spending a day at an amusement park is exciting. The park has many thrilling rides and attractions. I enjoy going on roller coasters, spinning rides, and bumper cars. The park also has fun games and delicious food. I like to try out different rides and see which ones are the most exciting. Sometimes, there are special events or parades that add to the fun. The amusement park is a lively place with lots of activities. Spending the day there is always a memorable experience filled with laughter and enjoyment. It’s a great way to have an adventurous day out.

Going to a local library is a pleasant experience. The library has many books, magazines, and quiet reading areas. I enjoy browsing through the shelves and finding interesting books to read. The library also offers programs like storytime for kids and book clubs for adults. I like to attend events and learn about different topics. The atmosphere is calm and conducive to reading and studying. Sometimes, I use the library’s computers for research or to work on projects. Visiting the library is a great way to enjoy reading and gain new knowledge in a peaceful setting.

Visiting a pet adoption center is heartwarming. The center has many animals looking for loving homes. I enjoy spending time with the pets and learning about their personalities. It’s wonderful to see how happy the animals are when they find a new family. I like to help by playing with the pets or volunteering. The adoption center often has information about pet care and responsible ownership. It’s rewarding to see pets find their forever homes and to be part of that process. Visiting the pet adoption center helps me appreciate the importance of animal care and adoption.

Attending a local theater production is enjoyable. The theater often hosts plays, musicals, and performances by local actors. I like to watch the actors bring stories to life on stage. The performances are usually well-produced and entertaining. The theater has a cozy atmosphere that makes watching the show enjoyable. I also like to see the costumes and set designs. Sometimes, there are special events or discussions with the cast after the show. Attending a local theater production is a great way to support the arts and enjoy live entertainment in a community setting.

I enjoy visiting a science museum with interactive exhibits. The museum has displays about various scientific topics, like space, biology, and physics. I like to engage with the hands-on activities and learn through experiments. The exhibits are designed to be fun and educational. I enjoy exploring the different sections and discovering new information. Sometimes, there are special workshops or demonstrations that make learning even more interesting. The science museum is a place where I can explore my curiosity and learn about the world in an interactive way. It’s a great destination for a day of learning and discovery.

I live in a house near the mountains. I have two brothers and one sister, and I was born last. My father teaches mathematics, and my mother is a nurse at a big hospital. My brothers are very smart and work hard in school. My sister is a nervous girl, but she is very kind. My grandmother also lives with us. She came from Italy when I was two years old. She has grown old, but she is still very strong. She cooks the best food! My family is very important to me. We do lots of things together. My brothers and I like to go on long walks in the mountains. My sister likes to cook with my grandmother. On the weekends we all play board games together. We laugh and always have a good time. I love my family very much.

Hi! Nice to meet you! My name is John Smith. I am 19 and a student in college. I go to college in New York. My favorite courses are Geometry, French, and History. English is my hardest course. My professors are very friendly and smart. It’s my second year in college now. I love it! I live in a big house on Ivy Street. It’s near the college campus. I share the house with three other students. Their names are Bill, Tony, and Paul. We help each other with homework. On the weekend, we play football together. I have a younger brother. He just started high school. He is 14 and lives with my parents. They live on Mulberry Street in Boston. Sometimes they visit me in New York. I am happy when they visit. My Mom always brings me sweets and candy when they come. I really miss them, too!

Every year we go to Florida. We like to go to the beach. My favorite beach is called Emerson Beach. It is very long, with soft sand and palm trees. It is very beautiful. I like to make sandcastles and watch the sailboats go by. Sometimes there are dolphins and whales in the water! Every morning we look for shells in the sand. I found fifteen big shells last year. I put them in a special place in my room. This year I want to learn to surf. It is hard to surf, but so much fun! My sister is a good surfer. She says that she can teach me. I hope I can do it!

Jack was hungry. He walked to the kitchen. He got out some eggs. He took out some oil. He placed a skillet on the stove. Next, he turned on the heat. He poured the oil into the skillet. He cracked the eggs into a bowl. He stirred the eggs. Then, he poured them into the hot skillet. He waited while the eggs cooked. They cooked for two minutes. He heard them cooking. They popped in the oil. Next, Jack put the eggs on a plate. He placed the plate on the dining room table. Jack loved looking at his eggs. They looked pretty on the white plate. He sat down in the large wooden chair. He thought about the day ahead. He ate the eggs with a spoon. They were good. He washed the plate with dishwashing soap. Then, he washed the pan. He got a sponge damp. Finally, he wiped down the table. Next, Jack watched TV.

Mr. and Mrs. Smith have one son and one daughter. The son's name is John. The daughter's name is Sarah. The Smiths live in a house. They have a living room. They watch TV in the living room. The father cooks food in the kitchen. They eat in the dining room. The house has two bedrooms. They sleep in the bedrooms. They keep their clothes in the closet. There is one bathroom. They brush their teeth in the bathroom. The house has a garden. John and Sarah play in the garden. They have a dog. John and Sarah like to play with the dog.

One of the sailors came to me and we started talking. He made some funny jokes. He asked me what I thought about the light wind. I told him I was very scared of the storm. The sailor offered me a drink. I got drunk and that night I slept very well. The next day, I forgot how scared I was. I also forgot my decision to go back home. Instead I was dreaming more about travelling by sea. The next few days the wind was blowing against us and we couldn’t move much. Three days later the wind increased and we could go faster.The next day there was a great storm. I was scared and this time I could see that the other sailors were also very scared. The captain was walking in and out of his cabin. He was quietly saying prayers.

I answer the telephone. It’s my mom. She sounds excited. She says they are going to have a party tonight. I ask, “What are you celebrating?” “The win of $250,000!” she says.I ask, “How?” She replies, “On a scratch-it ticket.” $250,000! I can’t believe it. My mom never wins anything. I’m happy for her, but I’m also jealous. I need $250,000.I go to my parent’s house. There are about 30 people there.Everyone is drinking, dancing and singing. My mother is very happy. I pour a drink. My dad comes over. He is also very happy. He talks about his plans. Firstly, he is going to retire. Secondly, they are going on a holiday. I can see they are both very excited. My mom gets everyone’s attention. She gives a speech and says thank you to everyone. She announces the win. Everyone claps and cheers. The party continues until late.

I ask my mom, “Can I see the ticket?”I go with her to the bedroom. She has the ticket hidden in a pillow.I look at the scratch-it ticket. I don’t see three symbols the same. I look at the ticket again and again, but still the same.I say, “This ticket is not a winner.” She replies, “Yes, look here!”She points to where it says: ‘Prize: $250,000’. I explain that she needs three symbols the same. Her mood completely changes. There is no more laughing and smiling. Her eyes and mouth are wide open. Her face turns white. She looks shocked. I laugh and hug my mom. Slowly she says, “I think I need another drink.”

Fifteen minutes later our ship went under water. We were safe on the boat, but I was still very afraid. We were soon close to the land and we could see many people on the beach. They were waiting for us. When we finally reached the land, the people were very nice to us. They helped us find rooms and gave us money to get to London or go back to Hull. I decided to go to London. I travelled to London by land. The whole way I was thinking what to do and where to go. I was too ashamed of myself to go back home. In London I met the captain of another ship who often travelled to the coast of Africa. He offered me to travel with him.

There is not much fun in being ill, but three window cleaners at the children’s ward of one hospital in London know how to cheer the little patients up. Superman, Batman and Spiderman abseil down the glass building, spreading smiles floor by floor. The superheroes then take pictures with the children. The man dressed as Batman later said that he enjoys the task. In fact, his son (who was dressed as Spiderman) was the superhero’s fan as well, and if he had been in hospital not feeling well, seeing Spiderman would have made his day.

I was young and strong. I became a slave to the captain of the pirates. I felt very sad. I was hoping the captain would take me with him when he went to sea. And when a Spanish or a Portuguese captain attacked him, I could be free. But this didn’t happen because the captain left me to look after his garden every time he went to sea.One day, I met a young woman in the house. She was so beautiful. She was also a slave and she cleaned the house. I tried to speak to her but she didn’t speak my language. But I felt that she understood me. I liked her very much. She was very attractive to me. Any time she saw me, she always smiled at me.

The next day I could run away. This was my plan. I thought about the young woman. I wanted to take her with me but I didn’t know how to do it. It wasn’t possible to take her on the boat. I was sad as I didn’t know what to do. I wanted to be free but my heart wanted to be with her. Then the morning came. I hoped that I could see the young woman in the house. I couldn’t leave without seeing her for at least a short moment. Then I saw her. She was the most beautiful woman in my life. When I looked at her, our eyes met. She knew something was wrong. Maybe she understood that was our last moment together. She looked deeply in my eyes, then she touched my hand. Her face was sad and my face was sad too. She smiled at me a little. Then she went away. This was the last moment I saw her.

One hour later, we were ready. I and the boy went to the boat. One of the captain’s relatives went with us. He was our boss for that day. Soon, we were far from the land. I pretended that I couldn’t catch fish. Then our boss told us to go further from the land. He thought we could catch fish there. At one moment our boss went to the front of the boat, and I quickly pushed him to the sea. He tried to swim back to us. I took one of the guns and pointed it at him. I told him to swim back to the coast if he wanted to live. After he swam away, I turned to the boy and asked him to promise that he would be faithful to me. He did as I asked. After two years of life as a slave I was finally free. We tried to go as fast as possible. The wind was good. We were far away from the pirate land the next day. But I was still scared of them.

I didn’t want to be caught again. I was so scared that I didn’t let the boy stop the boat for five days. On the sixth day I felt safer. We took the boat close to the land. We saw a little river. I didn’t know where we were. We had to stop somewhere because we needed some fresh water. We waited until it was completely dark. We wanted to swim to the beach unseen and get water. But as soon as night came, we started hearing horrible noises from the beach. The boy asked me not to go to the beach. We remained on the boat, but we couldn’t sleep. Two hours later some animals came to wash themselves in the water. They made horrible noises. The boy was extremely scared, and me too. We were even more scared when we heard one of the animals swim to us. The boy asked me to go away.

But I didn’t want to go away because we needed fresh water from the river. I took one of the guns and shot at the animal. I didn’t kill it but the animal turned around and it swam back to the beach. When the other animals heard the gun, they went away. We didn’t hear the noises, but we were still scared and we stayed on the boat until the morning. As soon as it was light again, we ate some bread for breakfast. Then we decided to go to the beach. We took our guns and two big bottles for the water, and we went to the beach. Once we were on the beach, I didn’t want to lose sight of the boat, so the boy went alone a bit further inside the land to get some fresh water. He returned after some time. He was running. I thought that some animal was running after him. But I didn’t see anything dangerous.

He was hurrying to show me he killed an animal that looked like a chicken. We were both very glad because the meat was good and we found fresh water. I didn’t know where exactly we were. I only knew we went around the coast of Africa. I hoped we met an English ship when we went around the coast. I thought we were in a land where nobody lived. We didn’t see any people on the land. We only heard wild animals. One morning when we were going to get water, the boy showed me a big lion sleeping in the shade near us. Then the lion woke up. When he saw us, he started to run to us. We didn’t have much time. The boy was so scared he wasn’t able to shoot. I had three guns. The first bullet hit his leg. The second bullet hit its head. He was seriously injured. The third bullet finished the animal.

When the people saw this, they stepped back and were soon quite far from the food. We approached the food and took it on board. Then, we weren’t scared of them. They came to us. We thanked them but we had nothing for them. At that moment, we saw two animals which were running down the hill. The people were scared. One animal attacked a young girl. I shot at it and I killed the animal. The second animal was scared and it ran away. The people were shocked when they heard the gun. They were also shocked when they saw the animal was dead. They were happy the girl was alive and they thanked us. They brought us more food and water. On the eleventh day, we saw a long piece of land which was extending very far into the sea. There were also some islands far in the sea.

I was thinking about going to the islands. Then the boy shouted, “Look! There is a ship!” And really there was a ship quite far at the horizon. The boy was really scared. He thought it was a pirate ship. But I looked at the ship properly. It looked Portuguese. The ship was going away from us. Nobody on the ship saw us. So I fired a gun. They heard the gun. Then they saw us. They turned the ship and went to us. Soon we were on the Portuguese ship. They spoke Portuguese, Spanish and French. But I didn’t understand them. Fortunately, there was a Scottish sailor on the ship. He came to me. I told him our story. Then all the sailors started to be very nice to us. They agreed to take me and the boy on the ship. We were both very happy. We offered our things to the captain. But he didn’t want to take them.

He wanted to pay for them instead. It was very nice of him. I told him he could buy our boat which I gave him a good price for. I asked for a half of usual price. He could take the rest of the things for free. The captain agreed. The captain also wanted to train the boy as a sailor. I didn’t like this idea. I thought he was too young for this job. I thought the boy also needed freedom. He didn’t need to start another service. But the captain said it was good for the boy. The boy wanted to work for the captain. He wanted to be a sailor. Finally, I agreed. The ship was on the way to Brazil. We arrived there after twenty-two days. I said goodbye to the boy and the sailors. Brazil was a new state in South America. Many people started a new life there. It was the same for me. I didn’t know anybody there.

Soon I met people who had sugar plantations. They became my friends. I liked Brazil very much and soon I learnt the language. I had some money from the captain and I bought a small land in Brazil. I started to produce sugar. I didn’t produce much for the first two years, but then my plantation was growing fast. I was single but my life was good. I was independent and my financial situation improved every month. We paid only small taxes in Brazil. The society was new and we didn’t have many rules from the government. Soon I had enough money to be able to hire a lady for cleaning my house. I asked my friends if they knew about any good woman. One of my friends said, “I have a daughter who is eighteen years old. I think she could work for you. She is also a very good cook.”

The next day his daughter came to my house. She was friendly but a little shy. She was also a very pretty girl. We talked shortly about what I needed from her. The next day she came to my house. She cleaned the dirty floor and my furniture. She took out the rubbish. She came to my house every morning on Monday and on Thursday and she was working for four hours. She cleaned the house and she also cooked for me. She gave food to my cat too who soon started to be a little fat. I was always happy to see the girl. Sometimes we had breakfast or lunch together and we talked. Then she was sick for a week. She couldn’t come to my house. I felt a strange feeling when she wasn’t in my house. I really missed her. I thought, “Maybe, I am in love with her.”

One week later she came to my house. I was really happy to see her. I could see she was happy too. I hugged her. Then I kissed her. It was a long kiss. Two weeks later I went to her father’s house. I asked him if I could marry his daughter. He was quiet. I was waiting for his reaction. Then he said, “I agree.” I was the happiest man in the world. Two months later I married the daughter of my friend. We started to plan a family. This period of my life was great. We had big plans for our family and our plantation. We needed a bigger house and we needed more money to be able to build a bigger house. I thought about the business in Africa. I knew I could make a lot of money in Africa quickly. I spoke about Africa with my friends who started to be interested in this idea.

One day, three of my friends came to our house. They told me they wanted to go to Africa. They asked me if I wanted to go with them. I said, “Yes, I want to go with you.” We started to prepare all the necessary things for the journey. Soon we were ready to go. I said goodbye to my wife and we started our journey. Our plan was to be back in two months. We left Brazil on the first of September sixteen fifty-five. Our ship was very big but we were only seventeen men. The ship was full of things for business. We had cups, glass, mirrors, knives and other products. At the beginning of our journey the weather was very good, but very hot. In one week, a hurricane came and it was threatening our ship for the next twelve days.

After the hurricane passed, we saw we went quite far from our original journey and were instead close to the northern part of Brazil near the Orinoco River. The ship was so badly damaged we could no longer go to Africa. The captain wanted us to go back and repair the ship, but I strongly disagreed with him. We went over the maps and decided the best thing to do was to go to Barbados and repair the ship there. When we started this short trip, a second hurricane came. The next morning one of the sailors cried out, “Land!” and at that moment the ship stopped in shallow water. We expected the ship to break apart at any moment because of the strong wind, so we all got into the small boat the ship carried. This was very dangerous because the seventeen of us were crowded in the boat, and it had no sail.

The waves were very big. The wind was extremely strong. The wind pushed us to big rocks. We knew the crash was close. Suddenly, a huge wave appeared and overturned the boat. I was covered with water and couldn’t breathe. I couldn’t see the others or the boat. But I saw a little beach between the rocks. Another wave carried me to the beach. I was half-dead with all the water that came into my body. I was still in water, but I felt a land under my feet. I could hardly move, but I knew I had to go further onto the land. I didn’t want another wave to carry me back into the sea. Before I could get to my feet, another wave came, and I was washed into the water. I couldn’t breathe for a while. But then another wave threw me back on the beach.

I tried to get up. I tried to go further from the sea. I was able to move ten metres up. I was safe. But my arms and legs were very weak. I collapsed and I was lying on the beach. After some time I got up. I looked for the others. I couldn’t find the other men. I was probably the only person alive. All my friends were dead. I only found three hats and two shoes on the beach. It was horrible for me. The weather was still very bad, but the waves weren’t as big anymore, and I could see the ship. It was far from the land. I looked around and noticed I had almost nothing. I was wet and had no other clothes. I had nothing to eat or drink and nothing with which to defend myself if an animal attacked me.

All I found in my pockets was a knife, and a little box with tobacco. The situation was really bad. How could I possibly survive with only these things? Before sunset I explored the place and I was looking for some fresh water. I found it in a small river. Then I made myself a weapon from a short stick to protect myself against dangerous animals. I decided to spend the night up in a tree. When I woke up the next morning, the sea was calm. I was surprised to discover that the waves moved the ship. The ship was now very close to the rocks where I almost died last night. The ship wasn’t moving. I took off my clothes and I swam to the ship. I didn’t see any way to get inside the big ship, so I swam around it twice. The second time I saw a rope which was hanging on one side.

I used it to climb up and when I was on board, I began to search for food and tools I could use.I was very lucky because some of the food on the ship was dry. I went into the kitchen and filled my pockets with biscuits. I was eating them while I was exploring the other cabins. I also found a bottle of rum which I took with me. There was no other boat on the ship and I needed one to carry the food and tools to the beach. That’s why I took some boards and I made a raft. I discovered three big wooden boxes and I put them on my raft. I filled the first one with the bread, cheese and meat I found. I found some more bottles of alcohol which I also put on the raft. Then I heard something. Somebody was on the ship. Who was it?

Somebody from my friends? It wasn’t possible. My friends were all dead. I was a little scared. I went to the place where I heard the noises. Then I saw who it was. It was a dog. It was a dog of our captain. Now, I had a friend. I wasn’t alone anymore. Then I noticed the tide was getting high again and the clothes which I left on the beach were already in water. I was still on the ship, so I looked for more clothes. When I was looking for clothes, I found a box with some tools. I also found a nice carpet next to the box. Then I looked for guns which I needed to protect myself and to hunt. I found 4 guns and 3 boxes of gunpowder. Two of them were dry. I put all these things on my raft. The sea was calm, the tide was rising and the wind was blowing to the land.Soon I was back on the beach.

I started to look for a place where I could stay. I saw a hill. I thought that from the hill I could see where I was. I took a gun and some gunpowder and I started walking to it. When I was on the top, I saw sea around the whole place. I was on an island. I could see two small islands near. One was to the north. One was to the west. I also saw a big land to the south. It was about 100 kilometres far. I saw nothing to the east. I saw only the ocean. I couldn’t see any sign of people on my island, only wild animals. I saw many birds on the way back from the hill. I didn’t recognize them. I killed one but its meat wasn’t good. I went back to the raft. I spent the rest of the day pulling the boxes and my other discoveries further into the land. While I was working, I was thinking that I had to go back to the ship again.

I had to get everything useful which was on it because the first storm might break it into pieces. I had to make myself a place for the night. I made a kind of a tent. I brought all the things which could be destroyed by rain or sun inside the tent. The night was close. I put some clothes on the ground. I wanted to sleep on them. I also put four guns around me. Then, I felt safe. I was tired from all the work. I fell asleep very soon. The next day, I left my clothes in the tent and I swam back to the ship. On board I made a second raft. I found a couple of bags with nails. There were also 7 guns, bullets for them, and some more gunpowder. I took all the clothes I could find. There were also some beds which I thought could be useful to me. I brought all this safely to the beach.

From then on, I went to the ship every day. In this way I brought many useful tools and objects. The third time I went I brought as many ropes and sails as I could carry. Some days later I discovered more bread and rum, and also some sugar. All of this I brought back with me to the beach. One day, I discovered a drawer full of scissors, knives and forks. There were also some coins from Europe and Brazil there. I knew the money was worthless on the island, but still I took it. I also found playing cards with pictures of the king and the queen. “I may have some fun with the cards,” I thought. It was my twelfth visit to the ship. The next day, I went to the ship but the sky was getting dark. Clouds were gathering and the wind was getting stronger. I knew it was no use making a raft when a storm was approaching.

So I swam back to the beach. That night the wind was very strong but I was safe inside my little tent. The next morning the ship was gone. I knew I had to make myself a better place where I would be more comfortable. I knew I could stay on the island for a long time. I wanted to make a nice place for me to live. I also needed to be safe. I could look for a cave. Or I could make a bigger tent. Maybe I could do both. I needed a place which was close to fresh water, which was hidden from the heat of the sun, and was easy to protect from both people and animals. Last but not least, it had to have a view of the sea, so I could easily see a ship passing nearby. I found a nice place next to a steep hill and I decided to put my tent there. The hill protected me from one side and I built a fence on all other sides.

There was no door, but I was using a short ladder to go over the fence, which I then took with me inside. I brought all my stuff inside and made two tents, a small tent and a big one.The smaller tent was inside the bigger tent. The bigger tent protected the gunpowder and the food from rains. I lived in the smaller tent. When I finished the tents, I started digging at the bottom of the hill. I was bringing the stones and earth I got from there to the fence. In this way I made a terrace on the inner side of the fence. I wanted to use the cave at the bottom of the hill as a cellar. One day, I was still working on the cave when a storm appeared. There was lightning, followed by a loud thunder. It came to my mind that lightning could hit one of the boxes with gunpowder. It could destroy everything and even kill me.

I was scared. As soon as the storm went away, I opened the big boxes with gunpowder. I started dividing the gunpowder into bags and smaller boxes, which I then hid in the rocks. I had a lot of powder, so this took me three days. I also went hunting every day. It was a break from the hard work and it provided me with meat. I also started to know the island and its inhabitants better. I discovered some goats and I hunted them. Then I had enough meat. Some days I was very sad. I thought about my wife. I missed her a lot. I thought about my friends in Brazil. I thought about my parents. I felt living on this island alone was meaningless. I often walked along the beach and I regretted my choice to travel by sea. I knew travelling by sea could change your life completely. It could be great but it could be horrible too.

I knew my friends from the ship were dead. It was horrible.On the other hand, I was alive. And I was grateful for that. I was also lucky to have all the tools, food, clothes and guns from the ship. Without them I could hardly survive a week. I decided to make a big cross. I put it on the beach. It was near the place of my arrival to the island. I wrote on it the date of my arrival. It was the 30th of September, 1659. I wanted to keep information about time. The cross was my calendar. I made a small cut in the cross every day. The seventh cut was longer. It marked the end of the week. The beginning of each month was also a longer cut. One day, when I was thinking about my situation, I realized I had a lot of negative thoughts. It wasn’t good. I decided to do something about it.

I made a list of all good and bad things that happened to me. I was alone on this island and I had little hope of ever going back to civilization. On the other hand, I was saved and I didn’t die in the storm which killed my friends. I had food to eat. I didn’t have a lot of clothes, but the weather was such that I hardly needed any. I had a dog. He understood some words. He understood when I said, “Sit down. Come here. Bring it. Don’t do it. Don’t jump. Let’s eat. Let’s run.” This list helped me realize that all bad things come with something good in them. I tried to concentrate on positive things only. I continued to make my place better and better. I made the cave bigger. More space in the cave helped me keep all my things organized.

Then I started to make some furniture. I needed a chair and a table very much. I used the boards from my rafts and the ship to make them. Next, I made shelves inside the cave. I arranged my tools on them. My clothes and guns were hanging there as well. I was very pleased with my work. The cave was comfortable, everything was in order and I could easily find whatever I needed. I decided to write a book. I wanted to describe my daily activities in it. It did me good to put my thoughts to paper. I started by writing down my experiences from the very first day on the island. When I got to the present, I continued describing interesting or important events in my life on the island. I decided to make a schedule to organize my time better.

Every morning I walked for a few hours. Then I worked until noon. I had lunch and I slept after lunch for two hours. Then I continued working until the evening. I was expanding my cave with the tools I had. I needed to make the cave big enough as it was going to be my kitchen, living room, bedroom and cellar all at once. When I almost finished my cave, a great quantity of earth fell down from one side. I was scared because this could have killed me if I was in the cave at that time. Afterwards I had a lot of work to clean the cave. The next week I spent putting long boards on the sides and also on the ceiling of the cave. I wanted to avoid such disaster from happening again. Little by little I began arranging the furniture in my new home. The next three days the weather was bad.

It was raining day and night, but it was still warm, so I continued with my tasks inside. It was never cold on the island. It was good for me. At the end of December I killed a goat. I also hurt another one. Its leg was broken, so I took the goat home on a string and took care of it. After two weeks the goat wasn’t scared. This event made me consider keeping animals, so I could provide food for myself when the gunpowder was finished. I explored the island and I found more goats in the valleys in the centre of the island. The animals were very shy, which made it difficult to approach them. I wanted to try to domesticate some goats. I only needed an opportunity to do it. I had a plan. I returned with my dog the next day. He was my hunting partner.

I told my dog, “Sit down. Wait. Don’t move.” Then I went around the goats but in a big distance. When the goats were between me and my dog, I hid behind a tree. Then I shouted at my dog, “Come here.” He started to run to me and the goats too. I stayed in my place behind the tree. When one of the goats was close to me, I jumped up and I caught its leg. I was holding the goat for two seconds. But then the goat kicked me with its second leg in my nose. It hurt a lot. I let the goat go and the goat was soon gone. We weren’t successful. This wasn’t a good way to catch a goat. We had to do it differently. I told my dog, “Let’s go home. I need some rest.” I spent the period between January and March working on my fence. It took me a long time because I wanted to make it very thick and strong.

Meanwhile I found pigeons on the island. They weren’t nesting in the trees, but in holes of the rocks. This made them easy to capture and their meat was good. I could also cook and eat their eggs. This is what I was surviving on while I was working on my fence. While cleaning and arranging my home, I found a small bag. There used to be corn inside, but now there were only some leaves and dust at the bottom of it. I emptied it outside my fence because I needed the bag for gunpowder. This was just before the rains. About a month later I was surprised to find a few green leaves growing there. It was young corn. Words couldn’t express how happy I was to discover corn growing just outside my fence. It was fantastic. I could bake bread in the future.

On the 16th of March, I was inside my house when I saw pieces of earth falling from the roof of my cave. I was frightened and thought all my efforts would be lost again. I ran outside the cave. Suddenly I noticed the ground was shaking everywhere. It was an earthquake! I was paralyzed with fear. Some big stones were falling from the hill. But I was lucky. They didn’t hit my tent. Although the earthquake was soon over, I was afraid to go inside the cave. I was sitting on the ground in front of my tent still very upset and scared to enter. I started to think that it was better not to sleep in the cave. It wasn’t very safe in case another earthquake came. But I didn’t want to sleep in the tent. So I decided to make a house instead of the tent. I wanted to use the cave only as a cellar.

The next day, I started to build the house. It was in April. It took me three months to build the house. But I was happy with my new home. I was ill in the last week of July. I had a temperature. I couldn’t get out of the bed. I was very weak. I could do nothing in that state. I had crazy dreams. The dreams weren’t very logical. But for me they were real when I had them.One of my dreams was really crazy. I was in a pub which was on my island. I wanted to drink some rum, but the waitress was extremely lazy. She sat at the bar and she did nothing. I didn’t like her attitude. I was angry but I waited. Then my wife came to the pub. She gave me a piece of paper with some text. It was a message from her father. He wrote, “Come home. You should work on the plantations.”

But I didn’t want to go home. I went to the kitchen in the pub. There was my mother in the kitchen who was preparing some steaks and she was also cooking soup. I tasted the soup which was fantastic. Then two Englishmen came to the pub. They wanted to sell me gunpowder. One man looked like a gentleman, but the second man was horrible. I told the horrible man, “I am sorry, I don’t need your gunpowder. I have a lot of gunpowder in my camp.” “What did you say?” said the horrible man. “Our gunpowder isn’t good for you? This is the main reason why we are here. We’ve travelled from London. You have to buy our gunpowder.” I said, “Thank you, I don’t want your gunpowder.” The man was really angry.

Our conversation was getting worse and worse. He said some horrible things about me. I said some horrible things about him. The conversation got to a point when he wanted to kill me. When he took his gun, I started to run away. He shot at me. At that moment, I woke up. One week later, I felt better but I still needed to relax. I needed to sleep a lot. In August, I was OK again. I still felt a little weak though. I knew I needed to do some physical exercise. The next ten days I walked around the island. This exercise made me feel better. When I felt strong again, I decided to explore the whole island. I found a new valley where I saw some tobacco plants among other unknown ones. The next day I found melons and grapes. I dried the grapes and I had raisins.

There were also apple, orange and lemon trees on the island which I didn’t notice before. I made a pile of the fruits that I gathered and I returned to my cave to get a bag for them. When I returned I found the fruits destroyed. Some were eaten, some were stepped upon. I concluded from this that there are some wild animals around. Still, I liked that fruit valley and I began thinking about moving there. Then I remembered that the beach was far away from that valley and I wouldn’t see if any ship passed by. Instead of moving to the fruit valley, I decided to build another house there, which I would visit from time to time. I made a small house, and then I surrounded it with a double fence. The house was protected like a castle.

Again, I used a ladder to go in and out. But I had also stairs on the inside of the fence. I used stairs on the inside and I used ladder on the outside. This activity took me the whole of August and the beginning of September. But I enjoyed it a lot. The fruit valley gave me so much energy. I felt so healthy and strong there. Sometimes when I was in the valley at night, I watched the moon and the stars. I thought about my wife. I thought about my family in England. I knew they could see the same moon, they could see the same stars but we couldn’t be together. I thought about my family very often. I wished the best for them. I also thought about all the people who could see the moon. I imagined the places where they lived. I felt connected with them. Sometimes I felt connected with the whole universe.

I also thought about God. I had questions for God. I asked him, “Why am I on this island? What is the reason for it? Why am I still alive when my friends are dead?” I didn’t have answers to many of these questions but I trusted God. I believed he knew what he was doing. Then the rainy season started which continued until the middle of October. This was my first year on the island. After the rains ended, I returned to my valley house to find the branches in the fence all green, with new leaves growing all over them. This wasn’t only beautiful but also useful to me because soon my house was covered entirely and was hardly visible. The leaves kept shadow over it and it was very pleasant to stay in there during the dry season. I liked it so much that I decided to make a fence from the same branches around my first house as well.

With the end of the rainy season, I thought it was the right time to put my seeds in to the ground. I was cautious so I only used a half of the seeds. This was a good idea because none of these seeds came up. I put the rest of the seeds in the ground just before the next rainy season and they came up alright. Now, I had a little farm on the island. This experience made me notice that there were two rainy and two dry seasons on the island. With this in mind, I could now plan when to put seeds into the ground. Soon I realized I needed baskets. With baskets I could carry more food when I made my trips around the island. I could also carry more fruit from the fruit valley. I cut branches from the same tree which I used for both my fences. After drying these branches, I used them to make baskets.

When I finished that, I decided to take another, longer trip around the island. After passing the fruit valley, I found pleasant grass fields. They were very flat. They had a lot of flowers. They smelled so good. A lot of insects were flying around these flowers. I could see some big butterflies. Their wings were ten centimetres wide. There were small trees around these fields. I found nuts on these trees. These nuts were different from nuts in England. They had a different shape. They were also sweeter than nuts in England. I also discovered that there were many parrots, rabbits and cats at this side of the island. I even caught one parrot and took it with me. There were also many turtles and other birds there. This part of the island was more pleasant and there was more food but I didn’t want to move.

On the way back my dog captured a young kid which I saved and took with me. I wanted to keep goats very much and now I was offered another chance. I left the kid in the valley house until I prepared a space for it in my first home. I was so tired from the trip that on my return I relaxed the whole day. I made a cage for the parrot and brought home the kid, which started to calm down. I made a map of the whole island. I put these newly discovered places on the map. The time passed so quickly and soon it was September again. This was my second year on the island. I was no longer as sad and desperate as I was immediately after the arrival. I accepted my destiny and I was grateful for being well and alive.

I still kept my daily schedule. I was hunting in the morning, cooking at lunchtime, relaxing in the afternoon when it was the hottest, and working in the evening. I also taught the parrot to say his name. His name was Poll. In the months of November and December I was busy with my fields. The wild goats and rabbits were eating the little plants. I risked losing all of it, so I quickly made a fence around the place where I put the seeds in the ground. I put my dog inside the fence to guard my corn at night. Soon the plants were tall, but then another danger appeared. Birds of all kinds started eating the seeds. I shot some and kept an eye on my corn until the rest of the birds were gone. At the end of December I had my first corn. It wasn’t a lot. I didn’t want to eat the corn, so I decided to leave it all for seeds.

My goal was to put the seeds in the ground again and have more corn later. Meanwhile I began preparing the tools I would need in a year’s time. I realized I needed pots to keep the corn. I looked for clay around the island. I found some and after two months of experiments I succeeded in making two large pots. To protect them better I put them in baskets and placed dry grass between the baskets and the pots. I continued making small pots and plates. I also made long but not very high pots. I put sea water in these pots. When the water was gone, I had salt. One day, quite by accident, I found a broken piece of one of my pots in the fire. The heat made it as hard as stone and it was very red too.

This gave me a good idea. I took one pot and made a fire around it. The pot was very hard after a few hours. I was happy with the result. I also felt a need for some other tools. For example, I needed a tool to make flour from seeds. I took a big piece of hard wood for that. I made a hole in the wood. Then I took another piece of hard wood and I broke the seeds in this hole with the wood. The flour stayed on the bottom of the hole. I thought, “I will need something to bake bread.” I had an idea. I mixed the flour with water. Then I took two stones. I put them near the fire. When they were very hot, I put the bread between them. This was how I made my first bread on the island. It was during my third year on the island. The bread wasn’t perfect but I liked it a lot. It was my first bread after a long time.

I was thinking whether I could make a canoe out of some large tree. I found one big tree. I cut it and I started to make a hole in it. One day, when I was working on the canoe, I realized I didn’t know how to move it from the forest to the beach. I was stupid. It took me many days to make the canoe and the thought of how I was going to put it in water never came to my mind. I tried everything to move the canoe. I even considered digging a channel from the beach to where the canoe stayed, but it was all useless. There was a hill in between and it would have taken me a long time to dig the channel through the hill. Eventually I gave up on the canoe. Many days of work were lost. I couldn’t believe that I made such a mistake. I had to plan my work better next time.

During my fourth year on the island my clothes were already very old. Instead I began using the skins of the animals I killed. I made myself a cap and some other clothes entirely out of those skins. They kept me cool in the heat and protected me from the heavy rain. But the clothes weren’t enough. I also needed an umbrella for the same purposes. It took me a while but I succeeded in making one.
